title: Wicket plugin manifest
description: The manifest.json at the root of a plugin's folder. Paths in it are relative to that folder and cannot leave it.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for an editor to check the manifest as you write it.

name.description: The plugin's identifier: agents submit to it, and it is unique among installed plugins. Lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter.

version.description: A semantic version such as `"1.2.0"`, or a positive integer that reads as `N.0.0`. The major version is a promise to every review created under it.

title.description: What the app calls the plugin in its lists and settings. Defaults to `name`.

description.description: A sentence on what the plugin is for.

icon.description: A Lucide icon name, such as `mail` or `git-pull-request`, shown beside the plugin's reviews.

payload_schema.description: What an agent must send: a JSON Schema 2020-12, inline or `{"$ref": "schemas/payload.schema.json"}`. A payload that fails it never reaches the inbox.

decision_schema.description: What the view hands back: a JSON Schema 2020-12, inline or by `$ref`. A decision that fails it goes back to the view as violations.

min_height.description: The smallest height, in pixels, the app gives the view.

settings_schema.description: The plugin's own settings, each a row in Settings › Plugins: an object schema of booleans, strings and numbers, each with a default, inline or by `$ref`. A schema that breaks these rules costs the plugin its settings, not its place.

shortcuts.description: The keys the view answers: listed in the app's keyboard help and forwarded when the view's frame has no focus. A list that breaks these rules costs the plugin its shortcuts.

keys.description: Modifiers (`cmd`, `ctrl`, `alt`, `shift`) joined by `+`, then one key: `j`, `cmd+shift+f`, `escape`.

does.description: The one-line label the keyboard help shows.

group.description: Lists the entry under this caption.

decision_template.description: A MiniJinja file that renders a decision as markdown, for `--format markdown` and Copy as markdown. A template that does not compile costs the plugin the template.

command.description: Run through the shell in a copy of the folder.

build.description: The command that produces the bundle, such as `{"command": "npm ci && npm run build"}`. An install from a folder or a repository runs it; a release never does.

dev.description: Marks a plugin under development in the app's listings.
